description: Create AI-generated short-form video clips from a YouTube video or uploaded file. Returns a request ID instantly. Processing takes 5-30 minutes. Costs 1 credit.

backgroundColor.description: Solid background color as hex, e.g. "#000000". Only with blurBackground=false. Omit to use the account's saved background color, else the template color.

blurBackground.description: Background behind the clip when the source does not fill the 9:16 canvas (mainly layout=fit): true = blurred copy of the video, false = solid color (backgroundColor, else the account's saved color, else the template color). Omit to use the account's saved editor preference (default: blurred).

captionLanguage.description: Caption language if different from spoken

captionsEnabled.description: Burn captions into the clips (default true). Set false for sources that already have captions.

ctaText.description: CTA text (max 200 chars, required when ctaEnabled=true)

customSourceLink.description: Own link for the Source line, e.g. "mysite.com/videos" (https:// added if missing, max 300 chars). Requires includeSourceLink=true.

end.description: End time in seconds (> start, max 1200s window)

fileUrl.description: Public video file URL (alternative to url)

gameVideoName.description: Exact game video name from list_game_videos (case-sensitive)

hookTitle.description: Add animated hook title at start

hookTitleDuration.description: Seconds the hook title stays on screen (requires hookTitle=true), e.g. 3, 5 or 10. Omit for the whole clip. The hook is always hidden while the CTA shows. Ignored by editorial and statement (always ~4s).

hookTitlePresetId.description: Hook title style (requires hookTitle=true). classic-pill (default) = black text on white pills; dark-pill = white on dark pills; bold-outline = white text with black outline; classic = one white box; native = Regular style: plain white left-aligned text like an Instagram caption; editorial = serif with a lime keyword; statement = condensed setup + big payoff; custom = your own design, set in hookTitleStyle. editorial and statement animate in and leave after ~4s; the others stay until the CTA starts (or the end of the clip), or for hookTitleDuration seconds. See ssemble://hook-title-presets.

hookTitleStyle.description: Your own hook title design. Required when hookTitlePresetId is 'custom', not allowed otherwise. Titles in Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi or Thai use a font made for that script.

backgroundColor.description: Box colour as hex (pill and box only). Pill also accepts 'none' for text without a box

shape.description: pill = a rounded box behind each line; box = one box around the whole title; plain = text only

textCase.description: upper = UPPERCASE (default); asis = keep the title as written

includeSourceLink.description: When these clips are later scheduled from the Ssemble web app (Share / Calendar), end each caption with "Source: <link>": customSourceLink if set, else the original YouTube video. Omit to use the account's last scheduler choice. Does not change the clips.

maxShorts.description: Maximum number of shorts to create (1-12). Keeps the highest-scoring clips and never pads, so short videos may return fewer. Omit to get up to 12.

memeHook.description: Prepend a meme hook clip (2-5s attention grabber)

memeHookName.description: Exact meme hook name from list_meme_hooks (case-sensitive)

musicNames.description: Several exact track names from list_music (case-sensitive); each short uses one of them at random. Use instead of musicName. Requires music=true.

noClipping.description: Skip AI clipping, process entire range as one clip

outroEnabled.description: Append an end-screen outro card (bell animation + "Please subscribe" text) after each clip. Default false.

outroHandle.description: Channel handle shown on the outro card, e.g. "@mychannel" (max 40 chars). Requires outroEnabled=true.

outroImageUrl.description: Public image URL for a custom outro card instead of the stock bell card. Requires outroEnabled=true.

outroSeconds.description: Outro duration in seconds (1-3, default 2). Requires outroEnabled=true.

outroSting.description: Play the short bell sound on the outro (default true). Requires outroEnabled=true.

outroText.description: Custom outro text (max 80 chars). Omit for the localized default ("Please subscribe"). Requires outroEnabled=true.

templateId.description: Caption template ID from list_templates (24-char hex)

webhookUrl.description: Optional webhook URL for completion/failure notifications. Receives a POST with results when processing finishes.

name: create_short
